background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Rated A- on average across all three, the weakest of them at BBB+, with one on a positive outlook and two on stable, the group's last rating move was a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015. Capital is the weak side, with CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% both below the US bank median, and leverage has fallen 0.6 points since 31 Mar 2025. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 128% in the top quarter and up 11 points since 31 Mar 2024. The news is mixed: an improved outlook flagged on 27 Sep 2026 against UK fines over Russia sanctions breaches at one of its units.
